### 📑 Citations

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}

library(scholar)
library(plotly)

# Your Google Scholar ID
scholar_id <- "RsZ9F8gAAAAJ"

# Get citations per year
cits <- get_citation_history(scholar_id)

# Total citations
total_cites <- sum(cits$cites)

# green
tail_green <- "#00563F"

# Create interactive plot
fig <- plot_ly(
  data = cits,
  x = ~year,
  y = ~cites,
  type = 'bar',
  mode = 'bar+text',
  text = ~cites,                    # labels = citation values
  textposition = "top center",      # position of labels
  line = list(color = tail_green, width = 3),
  marker = list(size = 8, color = tail_green)
) |> 
  layout(
    title = "Google Scholar Citations",
    xaxis = list(title = "Year"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Citations", range = c(0, max(cits$cites) + 20)),
    annotations = list(
      list(
        x = min(cits$year),
        y = max(cits$cites) + 15,
        text = paste("Total citations:", total_cites),
        showarrow = FALSE,
        xanchor = "left",
        font = list(size = 18, color = tail_green)
      )
    )
  ) |> 
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE)  # hide toolbar at top-right

fig

```
